author: Thoughty2
description:
The Hope Diamond is a jewel with a serious rap sheet that includes bankruptcies, madness, revolution and an astonishing number of deaths.

Supposedly cursed since it was stolen from an Indian temple, its trail winds through colourful characters including gem merchant Jean-Baptiste Tavernier, King Louis XVI, and wealthy collector Henry Philip Hope. Later, it passed through jeweller Simon Frankel, dealer Joseph Frankel, and finally Harry Winston before ending up in the Smithsonian museum.

So, is the Hope Diamond genuinely cursed, or has it simply been saddled with one of history's greatest PR campaigns?

And, just to be safe... should an old lady drop it into the ocean and call it a day?
title: The Diamond That Was Nobody’s Best Friend
